about.paragraph: I'm a data scientist and machine learning engineer focused on turning complex data into decisions — from LLMs and RAG systems to predictive models, deep learning, and production ML pipelines. My academic background in geospatial engineering adds a spatial lens to my work, but my core focus is applied machine learning and data science across domains.
